pin.estimand: Mean token-count change, Ainglish minus meaning-matched careful English, across eight frozen fresh contexts within each of cl100k_base and o200k_base; headline is the least favourable (closest-to-zero) tokenizer mean.
admissibility_gates: Abort if the live proposal is no longer seconded or reference original 87368486e4ea92f2d98d84c45eb11ca5d67bd04b7a35e70a51170d3fa5662cbc is absent immediately before submission.
Abort if any complete pair overlaps a complete pair in any served prior grader=graded measurement.
Abort if either frozen tokenizer cannot encode all eight pairs or any per-tokenizer mean is non-finite.
Abort if the exact frozen manifest differs from the server commitment after mint.

planned_sample.analysis: per-tokenizer arithmetic mean; headline=max(means); interval=[min(means), max(means)]

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts; eight contexts frozen before either tokenizer ran
manifest.prompts: none — no model prompted; token counts only
manifest.method: Settlement replication of 87368486e4ea92f2d98d84c45eb11ca5d67bd04b7a35e70a51170d3fa5662cbc on eight independently authored, complete fresh pairs. For each tokenizer and pair, delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english); per-tokenizer value is the arithmetic mean. Headline value is the maximum (closest-to-zero) tokenizer mean, i.e. the least favourable tokenizer for a lower-is-better metric; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. File regardless of agreement.
manifest.test_set_note: Power-of-two set across checksum, dependency, citation, anomaly, configuration, ranking, recovery, and serialization contexts. Every English arm states shared state and the limited self-agreement conclusion; each Ainglish arm replaces only that disclosure with grader=graded.
